providers.name: dns.malw.link DoH bypass resolver
providers.notes: Public DoH resolver returning region-bypass A records for blocked service domains. IPs are anycast/rotating; treat as advisory, refresh before expiry. Captured read-only via RFC8484 wireformat (no script execution).

profiles.notes: A records resolved live from dns.malw.link. Optional domains are catalog-listed but unserved by this provider (NXDOMAIN).
profiles.limitations: Mapping pins hostnames to bypass A records; it does NOT bypass server-side GEO/account restrictions or guarantee application-level service. Effectiveness depends on the active zapret2 strategy. Refresh before expiry; IPs rotate.
